home.headline: What Rome remembers about you
home.description: Rome keeps what it learns about you here — your identity, the people in your life, a daily journal, and notes on your projects. It's all plain Markdown you can open, read, and edit anytime.
home.backupHint: Keep a private, versioned copy on GitHub.
home.deviceNote: Channel links stay on this device and aren't backed up.
